name: dzql
description: Stories to documents to pages, and the compiled Postgres step: eta's modelling and rendering, and delta's definitions compiled to SQL

scripts.test: bun run test:setup && bun --config=tests/bunfig.toml test tests/; status=$?; bun run test:teardown; exit $status
scripts.test:setup: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.test:eta: bun test --parallel src/rendering src/modelling examples/chat examples/leave examples/modeling examples/starter examples/ticker examples/wedding
scripts.stories:all: STORY_BY_HAND=1 ETA_EXAMPLE=chat bun run stories && STORY_BY_HAND=1 ETA_EXAMPLE=ticker bun run stories && STORY_BY_HAND=1 ETA_EXAMPLE=wedding bun run stories && STORY_BY_HAND=1 ETA_EXAMPLE=leave bun run stories && STORY_BY_HAND=1 ETA_EXAMPLE=modeling bun run stories
scripts.test:fast: bun check && bun run test:fast:pg && bun scripts/fast-eta.ts
scripts.test:slow: bun run test && bun run test:eta && bun run stories:all && bun run costs --check
scripts.test:eta:ci: bun test --parallel=2 --timeout=30000 src/rendering src/modelling examples/chat examples/leave examples/modeling examples/starter examples/ticker examples/wedding

author: Peter Bunyan
